summary.key_theme: 中國市場准入潛在放寬與 AI 基礎設施需求強勁，持續支撐 NVIDIA 的成長動能與市場估值。

bullish.title: China May Reopen Nvidia's AI Market. How Will NVDA Stock React Monday?
bullish.reason: 中國政府考慮允許阿里巴巴與字節跳動購買 NVIDIA 的 RTX PRO 5500 晶片，此舉若落實將顯著擴大 NVIDIA 在中國的營收來源，為股價提供強勁催化劑。

bullish.title: Elon Musk Just Gave Nvidia Investors More Good News. Is the Stock a Buy?
bullish.reason: SpaceX 的 Colossus 2 超級電腦計畫在年底前將 NVIDIA GPU 數量翻倍，顯示頂尖科技巨頭對 NVIDIA 產品的持續高需求。

bullish.title: Nvidia Trades Near Its 52-Week High at Its Cheapest Valuation in a Decade.
bullish.reason: 儘管股價接近 52 週高點，但基於強勁的獲利成長，其估值倍數處於十年來相對低點，吸引長期投資者進場。

bullish.title: Jim Cramer Names His ‘Sacred Stocks' and Why He Won't Sell Them
bullish.reason: 知名財經評論員 Jim Cramer 將 NVIDIA 列為「神聖股票」，豁免於其嚴格的賣出紀律，強化了市場對該股長期持有的信心。

bullish.title: Nvidia Is Weighing a $10 Billion Stake in Anthropic's IPO.
bullish.reason: NVIDIA 考慮對 Anthropic 進行 100 億美元的投資，此舉不僅是財務佈局，更透過投資 AI 領先企業來確保自身晶片的長期需求。

neutral.title: ‘Don’t Ship Products Until They’re in Control’: Nvidia’s Huang Weighs In on AI Safety Debate
neutral.reason: 執行長黃仁勳針對 AI 安全性發表看法，屬於產業領導者的常規發言，對股價無直接財務影響。

neutral.title: Apple and Nvidia Are the Two Largest Companies in the World. Which is the Better Stock to Buy?
neutral.reason: 純粹的市場比較分析，旨在探討兩大科技巨頭的投資價值，未提供新的基本面資訊。

neutral.title: What Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Stocks Are Doing After That White House State Dinner
neutral.reason: 報導提及黃仁勳出席白宮晚宴，屬於社交與產業交流性質，對公司營運無實質影響。

neutral.title: IonQ Lined Up 3 Superion 256 Systems With NVIDIA, FIU, and SDT.
neutral.reason: NVIDIA 與 IonQ 的合作屬於技術生態系擴展，對 NVIDIA 整體營收貢獻佔比有限。
